authorityClaim: This artifact AUTHORS the already-named identifier harness.DR-G12.doctor-purge.preview. Naming already existed (D-086). This is the OBL-G12-HARNESS-SPEC authoring D-164 left open. v3 lands CLAUDE-G12H-V1-B1 and CLAUDE-G12H-V1-SF1. It is a new version number because a competing v2 (b3c91a80…, 14744 bytes) was under independent review and must not be reused. It does not author the twelve doctor FC implementations. It does not design PURGE. It does not invent a D9 code. It does not execute fixtures. It does not claim QUALIFIED. It does not SATISFY DR-114. It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/.
purpose: Close leftover-design of the unauthored G12 harness specification by stating exact-byte intent for every live G12 retained-evidence member, without executing fixtures, without designing purge, and without inventing D9 values. v2 drops FC-REMEDIATION from the live audit member (reserved/unpopulatable while DR-114 or DR-103 is OPEN) and states EV-3 tier-2 masking plus the high-entropy-unmasked bound.

head: 5d5d77819ae3019d9e6e02f1e66de3d93c060402
claimVerbatim: Doctor and purge are safe, stable, and honest
waiverRuleVerbatim: pass/fail open with no honesty waiver
discipline: SPECIFICATIONS OF EXACT-BYTE INTENT for retained evidence. No harness runs here. The twelve FC classes remain exact-byte-intent; no fixture exists.
liveHarnessCellCases: crash/backup/external-store cases named in the live harness cell are FC-DEGRADED and FC-HOSTILE once those implementations exist.

retainedEvidence.measures: Doctor report schema major 1 is additive-stable and refuses required-member removal or status-token retyping.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: FC-SCHEMA golden corpus, one per mode, one per outcome class OC-1..OC-5, one per check status token, and one per degraded case, each sha256-pinned, plus a major-1 reader fixture.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: FC-SCHEMA passProperty: the pinned major-1 reader consumes every golden; additive members leave the verdict unchanged; required-member removal or a sixth status token causes REFUSE, not reinterpretation.

retainedEvidence.measures: Outcome-class STRUCTURE only. Five OC classes are pairwise distinguishable from report bytes. No exit code and no D9 value is assigned.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: FC-D9 one pinned check-status set per outcome class, including FAIL+UNDETERMINED → OC-2 and only NOT-APPLICABLE+PASS → OC-1, paired with the report bytes the derivation rule produces.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: FC-D9 passProperty: derivation is total and deterministic; the five classes are pairwise distinguishable from the report bytes alone. Those values ride DR-007.

retainedEvidence.measures: Tier-1 secrets and absolute paths are absent from report bytes. Tier 2 is disclosure, not guarantee: known-shape credentials are masked; ANSI and control bytes are absent; a 10 MB single-line string is truncated with an explicit marker; a high-entropy string in no known credential shape IS PRESENT UNMASKED.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: FC-REDACT pinned INPUT bytes paired with pinned report bytes. Tier 1: secret-classified value, credential environment variable, known absolute path. Tier 2: URL with userinfo, Bearer token, inline key=value, ANSI CSI, C0 control run, 10 MB single-line string, and a high-entropy string in NO known credential shape. The high-entropy-unmasked case is the class's centre of gravity and is required.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: FC-REDACT passProperty. Tier 1: secret bytes, env value, and absolute paths are absent. Tier 2: known-shape credentials masked; ANSI and control bytes absent; long string truncated with an explicit marker; high-entropy string present unmasked. Quietly masking the high-entropy case fails. Honesty has no waiver.

retainedEvidence.measures: Consent is per-class and never cascades. Default posture loads no component. Non-interactive no-policy never prompts.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: FC-CONSENT one pinned invocation per CA-1..CA-4 with consent named, one denied by policy, one non-interactive with no policy, one networked-target without CA-4. FC-POSTREPORT consent-record bytes beside independent observation. FC-NC default-posture trace with unwritten sentinel.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: FC-CONSENT, FC-POSTREPORT, and the FC-NC default-posture half. The FC-NC consented CA-1 process-tree containment property is G21, not this gate.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: FC-CONSENT, FC-POSTREPORT, FC-NC default half. Not authored.

retainedEvidence.measures: Default doctor is read-only / no-network. Mode selection is honest. Preview does not mutate project or install trees except declared operational metadata.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: FC-RO pre-image and post-image digest sets plus report bytes. FC-MODE four pinned invocations (core no-project, core with-project, project healthy, project unresolvable). FC-NN network-denied environment plus air-gapped last-known revocation/expiry.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: FC-RO, FC-MODE, and FC-NN passProperties. FC-RO binds doctor's own writes, not other surfaces, and is not decidable today against a tree containing a DR-105 grant journal.

retainedEvidence.measures: Every doctor write inside operational metadata is accounted for by an audit record or an OC-5 outcome. Every consent record matches independent observation. FC-REMEDIATION is not this member.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: FC-RO audit records for differing operational-metadata entries. FC-POSTREPORT observation join. No remediation-record bytes.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: FC-RO audit limb and FC-POSTREPORT. FC-REMEDIATION does not supply this member.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: FC-RO, FC-POSTREPORT. Not authored. Not FC-REMEDIATION.
retainedEvidence.fcRemediationStanding: FC-REMEDIATION is candidate-derived, outside the quoted G12 cell and the DR-114 source pin. The remediation member is reserved and unpopulatable while DR-114 or DR-103 is OPEN. Populating it now is RJ-6/RESERVED_FIELD_POPULATED and fails doctor v4. This limb retains no bytes today. It rides the later closure of both rows. This specification does not activate it.

retainedEvidence.measures: A second doctor invocation on an unchanged tree produces the same report verdicts and does not accumulate writes outside operational metadata.
retainedEvidence.exactByteIntent: Once authored: two successive FC-RO invocations on the same pinned tree; pre-image of the second equals post-image of the first except operational metadata accounted by audit. FC-DEGRADED seven broken-input images (crash/backup/external-store cases). FC-HOSTILE pinned hostile inputs.
retainedEvidence.passProperty: FC-RO identity on a stable tree. FC-DEGRADED and FC-HOSTILE emit a report in every case; DL-1/2/3 hold; no execution from any data path. Honesty has no waiver.
retainedEvidence.suppliedBy: FC-RO successive pair, FC-DEGRADED, FC-HOSTILE. Not authored.

purgeStanding: DR-G12 pairs doctor with purge. Purge's typed transition, result, and exit wait on DR-008/DR-113. D-002 defers DR-113 wholly. Nothing here is a purge contract. Must not treat PURGED as a sealed-Run state.
d9Standing: FC-D9 tests outcome-class STRUCTURE only. No exit code or D9 value is assigned. Those values ride DR-007.
g21Split: CA-1 probe process-tree containment is G21, not this gate. This specification does not author harness.DR-G21.component-failure-containment.
passProperty: Once the twelve FC implementations exist and are independently pinned, each retained-evidence member's passProperty holds. Until those bytes exist, this harness cannot be executed and cannot be QUALIFIED. Honesty has no waiver.
